subject: general
question: Which of the following festivals is mainly celebrated in Arunachal Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Solung**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Solung Festival

 
 
• ​The Adis of Arunachal Pradesh celebrate Solung, their most well-known festival, on September 1 every year, after the sowing of seeds in order to pray for prosperity and a successful harvest.
 
• It is primarily an agricultural celebration but exhibits the socio-religious characteristics of the populace.
 
• Additionally, tribal people trade presents of meat and apong (rice beer).
 
• Attending this festival is the best method to learn about the culture and socioeconomic importance of the Adi tribe.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hornbill festival:

 
 
• It is celebrated in Nagaland.
 
• It is also known as the "festival of all festivals" in the locality.
 
• The festival is a representation of the Naga culture through splendid traditional music, dance, and performances. 
 
• The festival gets its name from the Indian Hornbill.
 
• It is a common bird among the folklores and tribes of Nagaland.
 
 

 
• Ambubachi Mela:

 
 
• It is celebrated at Kamakhya Temple in the month of June.
 
• It is one of the biggest congregations in eastern India.
 
• It is the belief that Kamakhya embodies the mother cult, the Shakti.
 
• The meaning of Ambubachi is* spoken with water.*
 
• Other fairs and festival of Assam: Bihu Festival, Me-Dum-Me-Phi, Majuli Festival, Dehing Patkai Festival, Kaziranga Elephant Festival and Ali Ai Ligang Festival.
 
 
 
• **​Wangala**
 
 
• Known as the '100 Drum Festival', the Wangala Festival is a traditional festival in the northeastern Indian state of Meghalaya.
 
• The festival kicked off on November 12th, 2021.
 
• The festival lasts from two days to a week. 
 
• It is one of the most important festivals of the Garo Tribe.
 
• The tribesmen make sacrifices to please their god Saljong.
